name: ratcc_viron_orbital6
_source: Six-position periorbital array after Hunold A, Ortega D, Freitag S, Link D, Antal A, Klee S, Haueisen J. Life 2025;15:820 (doi 10.3390/life15050820) -- E1-E6, 10 mm Ag/AgCl cups around the right orbit, counter at the temple (C1) or vertex (C2). This is the montage space VIRON group 2 optimises over with SimNIBS. Each cup is an independent source, so one run yields six basis fields and any montage is a linear combination of them.
_orientation: EYE-FRAME AZIMUTH CONVENTION (derived from this model, 2026-09-01). phi is measured about the corneal axis from +e1. On RatCC the fitted frame is e1 = (0.5, -0.5, 0.7071), e2 = (-0.5, 0.5, 0.7071), e3 = (-0.7071, -0.7071, 0), so phi = 45 deg is exactly +z and phi = 225 deg is -z. Radial tissue profiles from the globe centre: phi = 45 deg leaves muscle at 5.9 mm, crosses ~1 mm of skin (13) and reaches air -> SUPERIOR (dorsal); phi = 225 deg stays in muscle/fat past 7.6 mm with no skin -> INFERIOR (ventral, into the masseter); phi = 135 deg reaches skin at 5.1 mm -> NASAL/ROSTRAL (toward the snout); phi = 315 deg runs through fat and bone with no skin exit -> TEMPORAL/CAUDAL (toward the midline and braincase), which is also where the optic nerve leans (label 24 centroid at theta = 171 deg, phi = 323 deg). CONFIRM on the full 912x900x504 head model before publishing.
_crop: CROP LIMIT -- the 180x160x220 (15 x 13 x 18 mm) eye crop carries periorbital skin only for phi ~ 330..225 deg through 0 and 180; the inferior/temporal sector (phi 240-315 deg) runs out of the crop, and there is no forehead, temple or trunk in it at all. Contacts marked CROP STAND-IN are placed where the crop allows, not where the clinical protocol puts them; electrodes with skip_if_missing are dropped with a warning when the model has no landing site. Re-run against the full head model for publication numbers.

model._comment: strip the lab montage's own hardware before placing a clinical analogue: 101 = contact-lens ring -> cornea, 102 = J return -> periorbital fat, 110 = its insulation -> muscle

eye._comment: origin = least-squares centre of the retina shell, +e3 = corneal axis. RatCC 83 um crop: centre (89.00, 85.00, 91.00) vox, globe radius 3.155 mm (sphere-fit RMS 48 um); outer ocular surface 3.36 mm; limbus, the cornea(66)/sclera(33) crossover on the outer shell, at theta = 74 deg -> corneal chord radius 3.23 mm, i.e. a 6.5 mm cornea.

geometry._comment: orbital cup E1 at phi = 45 deg (superior); one of the six 10 mm Ag/AgCl positions of Hunold et al. 2025, scaled to the rat orbit. E1 is superior. || surface pad: a cylinder of the electrode diameter is landed on the skin along (theta, phi) and draped onto a 0.30 mm shell spanning -0.10..+0.20 mm about the skin surface -- the contact plus the ~0.1 mm of stratum corneum that conductive paste shorts out. overwrite [0, 13] lets it take air and skin and nothing else.
